centre.name: Ceed Centre
centre.about_html:
About Ceed Centre

The CEED Centre Society works to promote environmental and development education in the community. The Fraser Information Society was founded in 1984 as a non-profit organization and is now recognized as a non-profit organization.

Throughout the communities of Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows, we promote the development of social connections and sustainable living practices.

We operate as the Centre Neighbourhood House, a drop-in community center, and we own and maintain a registered heritage building.

We provide programs and services in the areas of community development and food security. Our partners provide additional programs and services.

Focus: How Was Your Week? Always confirm date and time here.

We believe:

  • that community should be built “from the inside out” by mobilizing the talents, skills, and knowledge of the people, organizations, and institutions in the community;
  • that all human endeavors should fit within the earth’s natural carrying capacity;
  • that all people should be treated with dignity and respect, standing equal and valued in the eyes and deeds of the community.

We acknowledge the financial support of the Province of British Columbia, the Government of Canada and members of our local business community.

Specialties

Amenities

Therapies

  • Holistic Therapy
  • Evidence-Based Practices
  • Yoga & Meditation
  • Individual Therapy & Counseling
  • Family Therapy & Counseling
  • Group Therapy & Counseling
  • Nutritional Counseling
  • Art & Nature Therapy
